findings.summary: no invitation list or revoke route exists
findings.detail: The manager surface can ISSUE (endpoint 6) and nothing else. `WorkforceStaffController` binds no GET for an engagement's invitations and no revoke verb, though `WorkforceInvitationState.Revoked` is declared and written by no code path in the module. So this UI cannot show whether a code is currently live, when it expires, or withdraw one that went to the wrong person — it offers a reissue (which supersedes in place and kills the previous token) and says so. Wanted: GET /workforce/stores/{storeId}/staff/{id}/invitations and a revoke route that writes the Revoked state.
